name: keycloak-mcp
description: KeyCloak Admin REST API for Claude Code, through a Service Account. Investigate accounts, group membership, sessions, MFA enrolment, brute-force lockouts, and login/admin events, and get a one-shot daily_brief health check. Runs read-only unless the Service Account is granted manage-users. Requires KEYCLOAK_URL, KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID, and KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET.
